title: Problem Details for HTTP APIs
summary: HTTP APIs need a way to report errors, and every API once invented its own format. This document defines a "problem detail" JSON or XML object that carries machine-readable error information in HTTP response bodies, so clients can handle errors consistently. It replaces RFC 7807.

eli5.summary: When a toy breaks, a good note says what broke and how to fix it, the same way every time. This gives web services one standard note for saying what went wrong.
